title: What Is Matter?
summary: Anything that has mass and takes up space is matter, even the air you can't see.

ib.note: Usually the opening idea of the first MYP science unit

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT: Matter in Our Surroundings (not in Exploration 2026)

objectives: I can define matter as anything that has mass and takes up space.
I can decide whether something is matter or not, and give a reason.
I can design a simple test to show that air has mass and takes up space.
misconceptions: Air is 'nothing' and has no mass.
Light, heat and sound are kinds of matter.
